newsitem.title: USA: Thomson combines legal publishing units.
newsitem.headline: Thomson combines legal publishing units.

text.p: Thomson Corp said Friday that West Group is the new name of the former West Publishing and Thomson legal Publishing companies, which were merged following Thomson's $3.43 billion acquisition of West Publishing last June.
It said Brian Hall, interim president of West Information Publishing Group, was named president and chief executive officer of West Group.
Thomson, based in Stamford, Conn., is involved in specialized information and publishing.
